# 2 Baruch Chapter 30 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**30:1** And-it-will-come-to-pass after-these-things when-the-time-of-the-coming of-the-Anointed-One is-fulfilled, that-he-will-return-in-glory.

**30:2** Then-all-those-who-have-fallen-asleep in-the-hope of-him will-rise-again. And-it-will-come-to-pass at-that-time that-the-treasuries will-be-opened in-which-were-preserved the-number-of-the-souls-of-the-righteous, and-they-will-come-forth, and-the-multitude of-the-souls-will-be-seen-together-at-once.

**30:3** And-the-first-ones who-have-come will-rejoice and-the-last-ones will-not-be-sorrowful.

**30:4** For-each-one-of-them knows that-the-appointed-time has-come.

**30:5** But-the-souls-of-the-wicked — when-they-see-all-these-things they-will-waste-away. For-they-know that-their-torment-has-come and-that-their-perdition-has-arrived.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. Chapter 30 is the resurrection chapter: when the Messiah returns in glory, the righteous dead rise, the treasuries of souls open, and the wicked face their doom. "Fallen asleep in hope" (v.1) is a key resurrection idiom.*
